core: Apical epithelial membrane polarity and transport
name: Apical epithelial transport with bile and phospholipid translocation
rationale: Members share apical/raft protein targeting and epithelial transmembrane transport (CFTR, water, microvilli), and unlike the confusables include canalicular bile salt export and lipid flippase/floppase translocation (ABCB11, ABCB4).

qualifier: sensory, sympathetic and branchiomotor cranial nerves
name: Peripheral and cranial nerve neuron development and innervation
rationale: All members concern development, migration and axon outgrowth of peripheral and cranial nerve neurons (DRG, sympathetic, facial, trigeminal, branchiomotor), distinguishing it from brainstem/hindbrain maturation and generic axon guidance confusables.

name: Phagosome acidification and its subversion by mycobacteria
rationale: Members combine host phagosome/endosome acidification and lysosome fusion with Mtb strategies that block them and suppress host defenses, unlike confusables centred on toxins, iron acquisition or bacterial entry.

name: Filopodium regulation and actin-based cell shape
rationale: Members share actin cytoskeleton remodelling that controls protrusions and cell shape (filopodium assembly, polarity, EPHB and RHOF signaling), distinct from actin filament biochemistry and dendrite/spine-specific confusables.

name: Endocardium, trabeculation and coronary vessel development
rationale: All members concern endocardial differentiation, ventricular trabeculation and coronary vascular/smooth muscle formation, unlike confusables focused on myocardial chamber and septum morphogenesis.

name: Bicarbonate and anion exchange in acid-base regulation
rationale: Members share SLC4/SLC26 bicarbonate, chloride, iodide, sulfate and oxalate exchange with CO2 hydration and proton transport, distinct from organelle acidification, Na+/H+ exchange and phosphate transport confusables.

name: Receptor-mediated virus attachment and endocytic host entry
rationale: All members concern virion attachment, receptor-mediated endocytic uptake and positive regulation of viral entry, unlike confusables covering specific virus assembly, maturation or host suppression of infection.

qualifier: myoblast fusion and satellite cell regeneration
name: Skeletal myoblast differentiation, fusion and satellite cell regeneration
rationale: Members share control of myoblast proliferation, differentiation, fusion and satellite-cell-driven skeletal muscle regeneration, distinct from muscle atrophy/adaptation and cardiac muscle confusables.

name: Nociception, itch and thermosensation via TRP and tachykinin signaling
rationale: Members share detection of painful, thermal, mechanical and acidic stimuli and itch, and unlike K2P channel and chemosensory confusables include TRP channels and tachykinin receptor signaling.

name: LDL receptor family turnover limiting lipoprotein uptake
rationale: All members concern LDLR/VLDLR-mediated lipoprotein particle uptake and its negative control by receptor internalisation and degradation, distinct from lipoprotein remodeling, HDL/efflux and sterol-sensing confusables.

name: Chylomicron and VLDL assembly, lipolysis and clearance
rationale: Members share dietary lipid absorption and assembly, lipase-mediated remodeling and clearance of chylomicrons and VLDL, distinct from HDL/LDL remodeling and phospholipid catabolism confusables.

name: Glutamate, aspartate and GABA reuptake and homeostasis
rationale: Members share plasma-membrane reuptake and homeostasis of glutamate, aspartate and GABA (excitatory amino acid transporters, astrocytic uptake, GABA synthesis), unlike glycine, vesicular loading and monoamine confusables.

core: Oncogenic receptor tyrosine kinase fusions and mutants
name: Oncogenic ALK, FGFR and PDGFR fusions and TKI-resistant mutants
rationale: All members are cancer-associated RTK fusions, amplifications or TKI-resistant mutants, centred on ALK, FGFR and PDGFR, distinct from FLT3-, KIT- and EGFR/ERBB2-specific confusables.

core: p53 regulation of apoptosis and cell cycle
name: Post-translational p53 control, p14ARF loss and G2/M progression
rationale: Members share p53 stability/activity control, p14ARF-defect evasion, p53-driven apoptosis and G2/M progression, unlike confusables on p53 co-factor/p21 transcription or radiation-induced checkpoint signaling.

name: CNS myelination, oligodendrocyte development and reactive gliosis
rationale: Members share CNS glial biology: oligodendrocyte proliferation/differentiation, myelin formation and maintenance and reactive gliosis, distinct from Schwann cell/PNS myelination and axon regeneration confusables.

name: Cyclooxygenase-driven prostaglandin and thromboxane synthesis
rationale: All three members describe COX-catalysed synthesis of prostaglandins and thromboxanes, unlike confusables on prostanoid receptors or regulation of arachidonate release.

name: RET-GDNF and endothelin signaling in enteric neural crest development
rationale: Members share RET/GDNF-family and endothelin receptor signaling driving neural crest migration and enteric nervous system/midgut development, unlike GI motility and sympathoadrenal confusables.

name: Hedgehog N-terminal palmitoylation and ligand release
rationale: Members concern N-terminal lipidation, exemplified by HHAT palmitoylation and release of Hedgehog, distinguishing it from Wnt acylation, GPI anchoring and O-glycosylation confusables.

name: GDP-mannose supply defects in congenital disorders of glycosylation
rationale: All members concern mannose activation to GDP-mannose and dolichyl-phosphate mannose and the CDGs from defects upstream of DPM synthase (MPI, PMM2, PGM1, DOLK), unlike DPM-subunit and later-glycosylation CDG confusables.

core: NAD and adenine nucleotide energy metabolism
qualifier: mitochondrial nucleotide translocation and creatine buffering
name: NAD salvage, adenine nucleotide translocation and creatine energy buffering
rationale: Members share pyridine nucleotide salvage, mitochondrial ADP/ATP and NAD transport (including viral-induced permeabilization) and phosphocreatine metabolism, unlike tryptophan-derived NAD and nucleotide interconversion confusables.

core: Long-term synaptic plasticity and dendritic spine maintenance
name: Reelin-linked long-term synaptic plasticity and dendritic spine maintenance
rationale: Members share regulation of LTP/LTD, spine and dendrite maintenance and memory, and unlike the confusables include reelin signaling and amyloid-beta response.

name: Colony-stimulating factor signaling in monocyte-macrophage differentiation
rationale: Members share M-CSF, G-CSF and GM-CSF production/response driving monocyte, macrophage and dendritic cell differentiation, unlike IL-6, SIRP and DAP12 confusables.

name: Cytokinesis, abscission and nuclear envelope resealing
rationale: Members share late mitotic events: contractile ring, cleavage furrow, spindle midzone, ESCRT-mediated abscission and nuclear envelope reassembly, distinct from chromosome condensation/cohesion and nuclear envelope breakdown confusables.

name: Netrin-mediated axon guidance and extension
rationale: Members share axon chemorepulsion/attraction and guided axon extension via netrin signaling, unlike semaphorin, ephrin and L1 guidance confusables.

qualifier: AMPA receptor clustering and short-term plasticity
name: Postsynaptic AMPA receptor clustering and short-term excitatory plasticity
rationale: Members share glutamate/AMPA receptor clustering and diffusion trapping with short-term excitatory plasticity, unlike confusables on receptor activation, kainate, NMDA and presynaptic signaling.
